page.layout: One page: a single map engraving with framed grid, labels printed on and around the map; a title-like line "SEPTENTRIO" above, "MERIDIES" below, "OCCIDENS" left and "ORIENS" right, grid numbers along the frame. No running text blocks.
page.notes: Engraved map of Chaldaea/Mesopotamia with numbered town symbols (numbers 1 to 50 and 19–21, 23–25, etc.) and the place labels above. The numbered town markers are not transcribed individually; the grid numbers at the frame are given. Some labels are partly illegible at the scan resolution; the "Caspiæ campi" and "Sigaram" readings are doubtful and marked here only.
